summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Cisco NetConfig Builder. Backend APIs 100% functional. Frontend UI working with minor overlay issues blocking some button clicks.

ui_bugs.issue: Toast notification overlay blocks Generate button click after Validate
ui_bugs.workaround: Wait for toast to disappear (auto-dismisses after 3-5 seconds) or dismiss manually
ui_bugs.impact: User must wait for validation toast to disappear before clicking Generate

ui_bugs.issue: Emergent badge overlay blocks Next button clicks in wizard
ui_bugs.workaround: Badge positioning needs adjustment to not overlap with navigation buttons
ui_bugs.impact: Wizard navigation buttons may be difficult to click due to badge overlay
